guard: owned terminal closure, leader-only space claim reads and broker-enforced account sweep isolation
why: The real two-account fixture drives startAuthService and the package-root reader/observer. Every transport fault patches an actual live nats.js instance in memory.
M1 makes the end signal settle while the callout is still live, so cell 1a refuses the false terminal signal.
M2 selects a nonexistent claim key rather than the package key, so cell 2a observes no held row.
M3 replaces the account-scoped native CONNZ request with a server-wide request. The unchanged scoped observer credential denies it and cell 3b rejects the incomplete observation.

mutations.name: M1 settle closed before callout end
mutations.expectRed: cell 1a: rejected owned close leaves closed pending
mutations.cell: cell 1a: rejected owned close leaves closed pending

mutations.name: M2 read wrong plane claim key
mutations.find:
const entry = await kv.get(PLANE_CLAIM_KEY);
  if (entry === null) return undefined;
mutations.replace:
const entry = await kv.get("plane-wrong-key");
  if (entry === null) return undefined;
mutations.expectRed: cell 2a: public reader returns held row
mutations.cell: cell 2a: public reader returns held row

mutations.name: M3 drop account request filter
mutations.expectRed: cell 3b: account filter returns complete live plane sweep
mutations.cell: cell 3b: account filter returns complete live plane sweep
